title: A weighted unit changes its influence
hook: Two stated cases: explore the inverse assignment probability of an observed unit.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the inverse assignment probability of an observed unit affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Weight, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the inverse assignment probability of an observed unit in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy unit has treatment propensity 0.2. Treated 1=1 uses inverse treatment probability; 0 uses inverse control probability. What weight results?

claims.text: Rare observed assignments receive large weights. Weighting cannot recover comparisons with no overlap or fix unmeasured confounding by itself. This comparison isolates the inverse assignment probability of an observed unit.
